text: I would like to share with Toronto City Council the Federation of Canadian Municipalities (FCM) latest Report for municipal councils, FCM-Report-to-Council-Nov2021.pdf. As a committee member, I am pleased to serve on the Social-Economic Development Standing Committee with Deputy Mayor Ana Bailão and the Municipal Finance and Intergovernmental Arrangements Standing Committee with Councillor Nick Mantas. The City's other members on FCM are Councillors Lai, who serves on the Board, and Councillors Bradford and Perruzza who sit as committee members. I am continuing to work with FCM and the City Manager’s Office in my determination to advance digital affordability across all municipalities in Canada.
